subject: itemfit question using S_X2 and p-value

messages.author: a29b76a7fee2ac43
messages.subject: itemfit question using S_X2 and p-value
parts:
Hi all,

I have a GPCM model and just did an itemfit(). The itemplot seems reasonable to me below:



But the S_X2 suggested that it was misfit (with p.S_X2 = 0.033, < 0.05)



Any suggestions on how to evaluate further of this item? Although this is not a Rasch model, I tried infit and it seems to suggest it is okay (within the threshold).

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: itemfit question using S_X2 and p-value
parts:
The graphic presented will be the same regardless of whether the item fits or not (it's the model-implied function, not the observed data). You might have to use other plot diagnostics to get an idea of the shape of the misfit, such as via the S_X2.plot or empirical.plot arguments.

Phil
